content.question: What is cross-validation?
options: A technique used to evaluate the model by partitioning the dataset into subsets and training and validating on them multiple times.
A technique for balancing classes by resampling the dataset.
A technique for reducing the number of features in a dataset.
A technique for generating synthetic samples of the minority class.
content.answer: A technique used to evaluate the model by partitioning the dataset into subsets and training and validating on them multiple times.
